name: Rocky Point Ale House
description: A neighborhood bar and grill on Broadway in Rocky Point with pool, darts and karaoke, a Wednesday open mic, and local cover bands on some Friday and Saturday nights.

dancing.notes: Rock and party cover bands play in the bar, and at least one band asked fans to come out and dance to a dance-rock set. A visitor review mentions a few high tables out on the floor. We could not confirm how much room is left for dancing.

evidence.note: A band's gig post for Rocky Point Ale House invites people to come out and dance and promises a dance and rock set.
